authors: Yang S.; Tang H.; Zhang X.; Bai W.; Xin J.; Huang Y.
key_contribution: Presents Gradient Perception Approach (GPA), a mapless navigation framework fusing geomagnetic vector gradient perception with INS using constrained Model Predictive Control for GPS-denied flight.
